analysis: The only change in this PR is a documentation addition to docs/developer/test.md. At head lines 551-561 it adds a section describing a test command for `LocalTokenizerByteFallbackTests`: a swift test filter, plus a description of Gemma 4 byte-fallback `<0xHH>` token decoding through `LocalTokenizerLoader`. The supplied units are base-text excerpts of unchanged surrounding sections (lines 921-1842). They cover App Attest dispatch, native serving qualification, cluster checks, cache SSD write-budget tests and other test guidance. No changed lines fall in the supplied ranges. No code, configuration, workflow, key handling, authorization, attestation, encryption, cache storage or wire behavior changes. The addition describes a test of tokenizer decoding only and adds no new attack surface. I checked the added prose against the threat model. T-041 (prefix cache) and TB-007 (inference engine) are unaffected. The tokenizer test uses a synthetic tokenizer and does not load weights, touch the network or handle secrets. The new text claims no production qualification and no control change. Remaining integration question: the actual `LocalTokenizerLoader` source and its byte-fallback decode change are outside this batch, so any tokenizer change they imply (for example, decoded-output handling affecting A-001 content) was not reviewed here. That is a coverage limit, not evidence of risk.
